description: Earth Observation for Climate-related Health Risk in Africa is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate", published or maintained by World Bank Group. The EOCHA Data Portal facilitates the access to heterogeneous datasets providing in a one-stop-shop the access services and basic data mining tools necessary to explore geospatial data i.e. in the context of the disease early warning systems. Coverage: the whole world. It has 1 file. The portal files it under Climate. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
